priorGap: The actual previous loading method directly awaited the async provider with no application deadline. A real offline/iCloud stall is not reproduced or claimed.

actualHelper.sourceTransformation: None: complete helper bytes + newline + fixture, same-file access for private gate tests. PhotosUI/SwiftUI wrapper compiles; only synthetic provider overload executes.

loadingIntegration.facade: Declared PhotoDataTransfer facade calls the ID-only async provider spy. It checks current/stale view-algorithm writes and failure resets, not the real helper deadline. Actual helper is tested separately.

sourceReview.firstWinner: Terminal state, continuation, deadline and Progress references are guarded by NSLock. Resume and cancellation side effects occur after unlocking.
sourceReview.callerRecovery: Provider start runs off caller. Finish resumes before scheduling registered Progress.cancel off caller; a blocking provider/cancellation handler does not need to finish for caller recovery.
sourceReview.dataLifetime: A terminal gate stores only a pre-continuation result; a successful post-registration Data payload is not retained. This is source review, not a measured memory budget.
sourceReview.lateProgress: A Progress that appears after cancellation/timeout is cancelled on factory worker.
sourceReview.limits: Provider start can race cancellation after the pending check. A permanently blocked provider/handler can retain its worker; caller recovery does not stop OS computation.

retainedFailures: Initial isolated typecheck failed because PhotosPickerItem requires the SwiftUI overlay import; corrected before final checks.
